constraints.description: Active, settled sine/triangle: commanded 1-1000 Hz, nominal offset 1.25 V and peak amplitude 0-1 V. Amplitude error <= 5% of commanded peak + 25 mV; cycle-average offset error <= 25 mV; frequency error <= 0.1%. Phase lag is separate. Inactive/reset/underrun output may be 0 V to supply; no glitch-free guarantee.
Every source, rail, load, timing and analog acceptance quantity must bind the actual selected components before A2.

Unremapped SPI1, mode 1 (CPOL=0, CPHA=1), 8-bit MSB-first transfers and 24 bits per SYNC frame. Meet every DAC p9 setup, hold, high-time and update-wait condition. Host low <= 0.15 V, high >= 2 V, transitions <= 30 ns and load <= 50 pF. Use 32-bit DDS, nearest phase word with ties upward; firmware <= 80 cycles/update and jitter <= 0.5 us. DAC p9 timing uses a 1 ns/V input-transition test domain; accepting host/board transitions up to 30 ns is an engineering applicability condition, not a manufacturer guarantee. The half-period budget does not replace the individual edge requirements.

Waveform table, buffers and state use <= 1 KiB: 257 16-bit quarter-sine entries (514 B), two 32-frame 3-byte DMA blocks (192 B) and 128 B state total 834 B. No 50k-sample RAM table. Stack and other allocations must fit the selected STM32 source 20 KiB RAM.

Accept separate 5 mV bounds for uniform pointwise DAC/follower residual and full-cycle mean residual including DDS/sample weighting. Neither follows from typical settling or jitter alone. Nominal offset is 1.25 V and commanded peak is 0-1 V; tolerated actual endpoints are 0.15-2.35 V, not a hard 0.25-2.25 V envelope.

Fixed 23 degC still-air bench. Effective powered PTC resistance within the selected 0.15-0.7 ohm post-reflow source window is an engineering acceptance condition, not an all-temperature guarantee. USB total <= 100 mA; OPA core <= 1.5 mA plus output <= 0.3 mA; LDO IQ <= 0.5 mA; control rail <= 50 mA. Selected F1 hold rating is 0.5 A at 23 degC.
